# VANCOMYCIN

# FOR PERITONITIS ASSOCIATED WITH PERITONEAL DIALYSIS

Vancomycin 30 mg/kg PD loading dose followed by 15 mg/kg PD every 3 to 7 days in 2000 mL 2.5% dextrose diaslyate solution.

[Click Here to order WITH heparin](orz-set-abx-pd-vanco-30mg-kg-15mg-kg-q5-7d-hep-low-mag-2-5)

If Heparin is contraindicated then:

[Click Here to order WITHOUT heparin](orz-set-abx-pd-vanco-30mg-kg-15mg-kg-q5-7d-low-mag-2-5)
